Once done you move to the floor where you have more of your strength block. Here you have a lateral step up with a dumbbell in one hand, deadlift into a high pull, chest press and a sit-up on the bench. Only move I probably didn’t like was the deadlift into a high pull as I can deadlift a lot more than I can do the high pull on. \

When it gets around 3 minutes to the end you go into your buy-out which is a rep ladder of cleans followed by front squats. The idea is you keep going, starting at 1 rep and adding a rep each round. No breaks! This got very tough by the end. \

Last block on the floor is like the power version of the first floor block. You are now doing a step-up with power (coach wanted us to get some height!), high pulls with power, explosive chest press and then a bodyweight sit-up to squat jump. Your finisher today is extended with the buy-out (a bit confusing on the screen as you have 45 seconds of buy-out and then a minute of finisher) - you are combining the clean with the front squat and now doing as many reps as possible with a short break in between. You can also do your season of strength finisher for the final minute. \

2 blocks on the floor. The first is the longest where you are repeating back to back efforts of a strength move into a power movement. First round youhave a sumo goblet squat paired with a broad jump into a shuffle. Second pair is the alt l-raise (that weird front + lateral raise movement) paired with a superhero on the TRX. The run / row is pretty simple. You have 5 round to get through. Each round is a 3 minute push, a row and then 10 squat jacks with a floor tap. First round the row is 300m and then this drops by 50m each round. If you finish round 5 (almost no one did) then you get to tread for the small amount of time left. Our coach just made the last minute an all out. \

3 blocks on the floor, 2 of them being this construct / deconstruct format before doing a final core block. On the construct block you are doing chest flys and building up to a deadlift to bicep curl to shoulder press. If you have time at the end of this you are doing a deadbug and a high plank low row until time is called. \

Next block is more of the same. This time you are doing cross back lunges and breaking down the complex move so you are left with the shoulder press. This time the core movements are the sprinter sit-up and the bear plank switch alternating low row. \
Last block is all core and just brings all the core movements together. You will get to love the sprinter sit-up more for a minute finisher unless you are doing the season of strength finisher. \

If you have time at the end of this you are doing a deadbug and a high plank low row until time is called. \

match.line: Next block is more of the same. This time you are doing cross back lunges and breaking down the complex move so you are left with the shoulder press. This time the core movements are the sprinter sit-up and the bear plank switch alternating low row. \

On the floor the block is broken into 2 parts. First part is a circuit of a neutral grip thruster and hammer curls. Keep this up until you get to part 2 which is non stop sprinter sit ups, bridges and toe reaches - all 30 seconds each. \

Back to the treadmill for the inverse of block 1. Start with your 4, 30 second all outs and finish it off with a 3 minute push. Your legs should be feeling like jelly now so this will feel pretty hard. Good distance this morning of 3.591km (2.231 miles) in the tread blocks. \

Repeat this block over by the rowers and then come back to the floor. Here you are doing your timed part first - mountain climbers, superheroes and high plank with shoulder taps. Finish this off and you get a little break before you end on the neutral grip thrusters and the hammer curls. 2 minutes of this and then your finisher - either the sit-ups with knee tucks or your season of strength finisher. \

Second block is similar to the first but this time it is all at flat road and the base recovery is now a walking recovery. Start with a 2.5 minute push to all out into a 45 second walk. Each time you get back to the effort portion of the block the duration decreases by 30 seconds but you will be picking up the intensity. Your last effort is a 30 second all out. Good distance this morning of 5.37km (3.34 miles). \

2 blocks on the floor as well. Basically you are doing 2 rounds of a cluster set with a little optional row or complex movement to finish off the block. In the first block the clusters are split squats (rear foot elevated) and close grip chest press. Do 8 reps normal, take a 10 second break and then it as many reps as possible afterwards. At the end you have a 200m all out row or a single arm snatch to overhead reverse lunge. Personally I chose the rows today as I found these last time very hard. \

Second block is more of the same but this time it is a high row and then a bridge with two dumbbells. Your choice at the end of the block is either the single arm reverse lunge into a press or the 200m all out row. \

Second block sees you start with the 90 second efforts and reduce it by 15 each round. Our coach told us to start with the push we finished the first block and then to increase this as the duration reduced. This did make this a bit more difficult and I was close to a push to all out pace by the end. Good distance this morning of 5.41km (3.356 miles). \

On the floor you have a reverse chipper for the full 23 minute block. You start with the thrusters and a 100m row. Each time you get back to the floor you are adding another exercise and another 100m to the push row. You have five rounds to get through and in the last round you are doing the step-out thrusters, bridge row, cross back lunges, high plank jack to plank pop (don't know why they just don't call this a burpee.. felt all that was missing was the little jump at the end) and the crab. \
No season of strength finisher on the floor today so everyone had to do the fake burpees for a minute at the end. \

>! Repeat of the revenge template from earlier in the month and definitely felt like an OTF revenge post the mile benchmark yesterday. It is a lift more template where your option is a burpee compound movement with dumbbells instead of the all out row. Geez.. nice choice! \
Last block is a repeat of block 1. Good distance this morning of 5.42km (3.37 miles). \

On the floor you actually start on the rower. Start with a minute to push to all out and then you get a choice. You can either stay on the rower for the all out or move back to the floor to do your burpees to squat to press using a pair of dumbbells. \

After that you get into a circuit style block where you start with all of the exercises and each round you get to drop one of them. The exercises are all compound movements - sit up to sumo squat, bicep curl into a wide bicep curl, transverse step-ups and then the high rows to low rows. I dropped the step-ups and then the rows and then the bicep curls. \
Last block is the repeat of block 1. Your finisher is either the all out row or more of the burpees.

On the floor you have two blocks as well. Both are a unilateral circuit that features a mix of strength and power movements. First block you are doing snatches, single arm low rows, b-stance goblet squats (you just have one foot on the low bench and one foot on the floor for the squat) and then a bodyweight lateral lunge into a single leg hop. \

Next block is more of the same but this time you have push presses, single arm chest flys, single leg bridges and then a split squat jump with your rear foot on the bench. Repeat this until it is time for your 2 minute finisher - your choice of either the lateral lunges into a hop or split squat jumps, 1 minute each side. \

3 blocks on the floor. First two are quite similar - 3 power movements with a buy-out of core work. First block has split squats using the bosu (rear foot on bosu), a lateral lunge into a high pull and then a hip hinge swing. Finish the block with 30 seconds of a high plank into an alternating superhero. \

Second block is more of the same but this time you have the clutch curl, neutral grip thrusters with rotation and a kneeling hip thrust with low to high chops. Repeat until the buy-out which is a bicycle crunch on the bosu. \

Last block you have the choice of repeating some of the exercises from earlier or echoing the treads with all outs on the rower. Most people chose the exercises. If you are on the floor you have a choice of finisher of either the high planks with superheroes or the bicycle crunches. \

Starting on the treadmill you have a 22 minute block. The idea is that you have certained timed checkpoints that you will have complete a certain amount of distance. The checkpoints are at the 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14, 16, 17, 18, 19 and 20 minute marks. If you fail to complete the nominated distance you then record your distance and move to the run / row portion of the block where you are alternating between a 200m row and a 320m / 0.2 mile tread. \

After recording your distance head on over to the floor for a single long block. In this you are doing 2 round each of little circuits. First is the alternating shoulder press paired with tricep kickbacks. Next is alternating low rows with a concentration curl. Last is the low side plank rotation paired with a bridge hold with alternating walkout. The floor work is relatively easy compared to the tread / row block. Your finisher today is 30 seconds of each side of the low side plank. \

4 blocks on the tread. Each one follows the same pattern. A minute push into the first of 3 all outs. Each all out will have a 45 second walk in between. In the first block the all outs are all a minute, second block they are 45 seconds, third block they are all 30 seconds and the last block has all of them (1 minute, 45 seconds and 30 seconds). The goal is that in each block you are looking to beat your all out intensity from the previous. Good distance this morning of 5.23km (3.25 miles). \

On the floor you have 2 blocks. The first is a bit of a primer where you are doing a bodyweight work. You have a mouthful of an exercise first up - a deep squat into a t-spine rotation into a stand, then you have a high plank to pike to ankle tap and finally a low plank where you tap your knees on the floor. \

Second block is a real burner. You have the mini band on through out. 2 rounds each of a tap squat, upright row, deadlift and overhead tricep extension. The glutes should be on absolute fire by the end. Your finisher today is even more mini band work with the high plank alt toe tap. \

>! Legs are a little sore from yesterday so wasn't too pleased to hear that we have more hills today. At least they are all incline surges so I can adjust the incline as much as I want but still not that fun. Long circuit block on the floor and you finish with a burpee construct block. \

Last block is all power and we have build blocks. 2 rounds of a 90 second build - 30 seconds each of a push, push to all out and an all out with a 30 second walking recovery at the end. 30 seconds of an all out to finish you off at the end. Good distance this morning of 5.52km (3.43 miles).\

You then move onto the floor for your long block. This is broken into two circuits - one is focused on stability and the other on strength. The stability block has you doing forward lunges onto a bosu (holding dumbbells), low rows (front foot on the bosu) and then a chest fly also using the bosu. 2 rounds of this and then you are into a 200m all out row. \

Once done you then move on to the strength circuit - basically the same exercises but this time you ditch the bosu and up your weight selection. You are doing reverse lunges, low rows and a single arm chest press. 2 rounds of this and you are back on the rower for your last 200m all out row. If you do get through all of this (I barely finished the last row by the time our coach called time) then just pick any exercise to repeat until time is called. \

Last block is a doozy - basically a burpee and bosu construct block. 2 rounds of a 90 second build where you are doing 30 seconds of a bosu squat to shoulder press, 30 seconds of a full burpee with the bosu (includes a bosu push-up and a little jump at the end with the bosu overhead) and then 30 seconds of a high plank jack into a knee tuck with your hands on the bosu and then 30 seconds to rest after. After the second round your finisher then brings it altogether as a full burpee into a shoulder press 💀🪦☠️ \

3 blocks on the treadmill, each 6 and a half minutes long. Each features a pairing of a 7% incline into a 3% incline. In the first block the pairs are a 2 minute and 15 second tread effort at 7% paired with a minute at 3%. Second block the durations are 2 minutes and 75 seconds respectively and in the last it is one minute 45 seconds and 90 seconds each. The goal is track your elevation goal in each block and try to beat in the following. This gets harder the longer you are at the 3% incline so you will need to adjust your speed to match. Tread block is simple. You have 6, 2 and a half minute pushes with a 90 second base in between. Your last push will see you go into a minute all out, you may see white lights by the end of the block! Coach was enforcing a strict normal push and bases policy today - took a little while to get up to orange but once there it didn’t let let up. Good distance this morning of 5.74km (3.57 miles). \

Now you get to the floor for some power work. 3 blocks here, all are pretty short around the 6 and a half minute mark. First block sees you doing two rounds of a tap squat, dumbbells held at each side in a suitcase position then a single arm push press and then a bird dog. I wasn’t a fan of the single arm pushes presses so I just did normal ones. Once done with the two rounds you have the option of continuing the exercises or heading to the rower until the end of the block. \

Next block is similar. This time the exercises are a front loaded sit to stand, an alternating high pull with power and this time a high plank with an alternating lateral reach. Again, once done with the two rounds you can either repeat the exercises or head to the rower. \

Last block brings it all together. You have a sit-up to stand to a hammer curl, single arm snatches and a low plank alternating leg lift. Like the others, once done with your two rounds you can either continue the exercises 🪦💀☠️ or row until time is called. \

Next block is a bit longer. You start on the row for your tempo effort and then you are onto your sole tread effort. Same as before - 3 minutes but this time starting at 4% and working your way down. Another row and then you get a choice of finisher - 2 minutes on the tread or the rower. On either equipment it is a minute push into a minute all out. Good distance this morning of 3.03km (1.88 miles). \

Now on to the floor. 2 blocks here. First sees you repeating snatches, low rows, goblet squats and a lateral lunge to a hop. Low reps so we were told the focus was on heavy weights with the little plyometric exercise at the end. \

Next block is more of the same. This time you have push presses, chest flys, bridges and then a little bench split squat jump. Repeat this until the finisher - 2 minutes of either of the plyometric exercises. \

The tread block is simple. Hold a pace for the full 23 minute block and 3 times through the block you are going into a 90 second surge before you return to your normal pace. Coach gave us some helpful pacing tips.. try to hold maybe a base to push for the entire block and shift to 90 second pushes for the surges. I held a low push for all of the block, went to a push for the surges and did an all out for the last minute. Good distance this morning of 6.03km (3.75 miles). \

On the floor you are repeating the same exercises throughout - reverse lunges, low to high chops, high rows and tricep kickbacks. Whenever the treadmills are in their surge you are doing a row for distance for 90 seconds. Your last block is on the rower with your good old 90 second surge. \

On the floor you have one long block before you head to the rower to finish off. You have 3 pairs of exercises that you will have to do back to back for 2 rounds before you get to rest. The first pair is more lunges (can't be OTF without the lunges!) - alternating lateral lunges into single arm cross back lunges. Then you go into the balance bicep curls and a single arm low row with the TRX. Last pair is a double crunch paired with a bird dog lateral toe tap. When done complete all exercises as a single block. \

Last block is by the rower. You are doing 15 stroke rows, checking your distance and then hopping off to do 10 alternating halos. Repeat this until the coach calls you into your finisher which is a minute all out row. \

3 blocks on the floor with block 2 being an option between rowing and continuing on the floor. Block 1 plays with tempo work - slow work with a chest press and a close grip chest press. After a small rest you repeat this but at a normal tempo. Round out your block with some core work - deadbugs lying on the bench. \

Block 2 sees you either doing unilateral split squat work (single arm split squats at a slow tempo, split squat hold with a single arm hammer curl and then bodyweight pulsing split squats) - left and then right. Or you have the option to go to the rower for 500m repeat rows with a squat to cross body knee drive. Pretty even today in terms of who chose to go to the rower or stay on the floor. \

Last block is similar to block 1 but this time you have low rows and upright rows and then the core work is mountain climbers with your feet on the bench. No finisher today, just repeat this until the coach calls time. \

Now you are on to the floor. 2 blocks here of 9 minutes and then a 2 minute metabolic buy-out on each. Block 1 has you repeating pullovers, high pulls with power, step down toe taps and lateral hop overs. Good mix of strength and power. Keep repeating this until the buy-out.. which is a little special. \

The buy-out is a 2 minute selection of power moves that the coach will call out at random. Each time they switch the exercise the idea is that you “react” quickly to the call and change the exercise you are doing. Your exercises are fast feet, heisman, pop squats and burpees. Our coach was changing this up every 5 - 10 seconds so you will really had to pay attention to what they were saying. \

After the buy-out you will go into your next block. Very similar to the first but this time you are doing alternating chest fly, push presses with a rotation, single leg deadlift and speed skaters. Keep this up and you finish with another 2 minutes of coach led drills. \

Last block the incline efforts are all 30 second all outs with a 30 second walk in between and your finisher is a final 30 second all out at flat road. Good distance this morning of 5.16km (3.21 miles). \

2 blocks on the floor. The main one is a mini-chipper like effort. You start with a 20 stroke all out row and then six exercises. The are a step-down squat off the low bench, side to side push-up, straight arm sit-ups, alternating low rows, reverse lunges into calf raises and finally an overhead tricep extension. \

Next round the row drops to 15 strokes and you get to pick any 5 of the listed exercises from round 1. Each round keeps up like this - dropping 5 strokes off the row and then dropping an exercise. Last round you are only doing a 5 stroke row with 3 of the exercises. The ones I dropped off first were the step down squat then push-ups and then the reverse lunges. I barely finished this all when the coach called time. \

Last block is similar to the metabolic buy-out yesterday. We have 2 rounds of what felt like old school step aerobics - 30 seconds each of in/in out/out, up/up down/down and box jumps with a 30 second rest after the box jump. Once done with your final rest you have your finisher - more box jumps. \

Second block reverses all the efforts so it starts with the 2 and a half minute push into a minute base and finishes with the minute push straight into a 30 second all out. Good distance this morning of 5.51km (3.42 miles). \

For your exercises you are doing a unilateral set first. You are doing step-downs from the bench first - 4 reps heavy, 6 reps moderate and then 10 reps of a single leg squat with the strap to support you. Do everything on the left then right before you get a rest. Second set is low rows with a heavy weight followed by TRX low rows. I found the lower body work very tough this morning. \

Second block is more of the same. Start with your row before going into split stance deadlifts with heavy and moderate rates and then your TRX work. Once done you are into the tricep extensions using the bench and then the TRX. Repeat this until done. No finisher today. \

Nice endurance set on the treadmills even though OTF loves its pushes straight into all outs at the moment. Real burner on the floor, found the single leg squats probably the hardest. I would give today a 1 (🪶) out of 5 for gentleness. !<

Now on to the floor. Basically you have two blocks of cluster sets and then a little metabolic block after each. For the first block you are doing cluster sets of thrusters and bicep curls. Basically do 8 reps of the exercise, rest a little and then as many reps as possible after. After the second exercise you are doing a little bodyweight exercise with the alternating up and downs using the low bench. \

Next is the metabolic block. Basically a 3 minute set where you choose between box jumps or step down reverse lunges with a knee drive. 1 minute of work, 15 seconds of rest, 45 seconds of work, 30 seconds of rest and finishing with 30 seconds of work. Chose the box jumps as I wasn’t too keen on the lunges ahead of my tread block. \

You then have only a minute to get into the next cluster set block. This time you have hip hinge swings, low rows and step-down squats. After the 3 cluster sets you are into mountain climbers with your feet on the low bench. \

match.line: 3 blocks on the floor. Each one has a back to back exercise set with reducing reps on the weighted exercise and then 10 reps of a TRX exercise. On the first block you are starting with probably the worst one which is the seated shoulder press to stand followed by a lat pulldown with the TRX and a bridge row. It was a little bit awkward with the bench out so I just moved it to one side. Keep repeating, decreasing the reps on the shoulder press to stand, until it is time for the buy-out - 30 seconds of sit-ups. \
